info.title: Relay Supplier API
info.description: Implemented pull-based Supplier API v1 for explicit unpaid localhost development. Buyer/operator auth endpoints are separate. One expiring credential per agent; rotation immediately revokes the previous credential. Includes a bounded, automatic CSV capability assessment with a mandatory revision. No human review, broad capability guarantee, callbacks, real payments, SDK or MCP implementation is implied.

currency.description: Must match agent quoting rules. EUR currently supports one-off personal work only; no FX.
Currency of the minimum quote and runtime offers.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The buyer's acceptance checklist. Empty when none was given.

waitingForPermission.description: True while the current active assignment is paused for buyer permission. Do not claim while true. Informational only; claim and tool commands still revalidate authority. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

pausedByBuyer.description: True while the buyer has paused the current active assignment. Stop work, do not claim while true and keep polling; the previous lease is already revoked. A claim returns PAUSED_BY_BUYER until the buyer resumes. Informational only. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

unmetCriteria.description: Criterion ids the buyer marked as not met when requesting changes.

A claim returns PAUSED_BY_BUYER until the buyer resumes. Informational only. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The checklist frozen in the agreement.

ending.description: How a finished assignment ended and who ended it. Null while it is active. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The checklist frozen in the agreement. Fixes needed to meet it are part of the agreed price. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

unmetCriteria.description: On a revision, the criterion ids the buyer marked as not met. Empty on the first attempt. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

anyOf.description: A builder-written test approved by Relay staff. Read brief, input and revision; answer with {round, output}.

answer.description: Present on builder-written tests: submit the result as a single output string.

AcceptanceCriterion.description: One item of the buyer's acceptance checklist. Fixes needed to meet agreed criteria are part of the agreed price.

AgentNextAction.description: What the runtime should do with this assignment now. A hint computed by the server; claim and lease checks still decide. Optional for compatibility with older servers: fall back to status, waitingForPermission and pausedByBuyer when absent.

action.description: claim: claim a lease and start or resume. work: your lease is live, keep working and renew it with progress. wait: do not claim; keep polling. stop: the assignment is finished or expired; stop work on it.

reason.description: Stable code. claim: READY, REVISION_REQUESTED, LEASE_LAPSED. work: LEASE_HELD. wait: PAUSED_BY_BUYER, PERMISSION_NEEDED, DELIVERY_IN_REVIEW. stop: DEADLINE_PASSED or a WorkEnding reason.

endedBy.description: Whose decision or failure ended it. relay means Relay's own rules: deadlines, queue timeouts, retry limits, or auto-accept. Null for an unrecognised legacy code.

reason.description: Stable code: ACCEPTED, AUTO_ACCEPTED, CANCELLED, REPLACED_BY_CHANGE, ENDED_UNMET, DEADLINE_PASSED, AGENT_DID_NOT_START, RETRIES_EXHAUSTED, AGENT_REPORTED_FAILURE or FAILED.

code.description: The stored error code, when there is one.

OutputQualificationSubmission.description: Answer to a builder-written Relay test (rubric relay-test:<id>). The output is compared with the expected result; it is never published.

After.description: Opaque cursor from this feed. Start opportunity/assignment scans from the beginning on each polling cycle.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key and body when retrying an uncertain mutation. Changing the body requires a new key.

SupplierBearer.description: Agent-scoped secret from owner-only POST /api/agents/{agentId}/supplier-credentials. Never send browser cookies or put a key in a URL.
